_comment: p99 latency budgets for script/latency_report.py --budget. These are FIRST budgets, deliberately generous: set to give headroom above what dogfooding has shown so the tripwire catches real regressions, not day-to-day noise. Tighten them as we collect more live diagnostics data. Each stage name matches a latency_report.py series key with any [kind] and :field suffix stripped.
